lines: In other bodies self, other from own body; should see moving, from loss and gain standing in coming-going place.
l4.sanskrit_cite: paradeheṣu cātmānaṃ paraṃ cātmaśarīrataḥ paśyeccarantaṃ hānādādgamāgamapadasthitam
